name: phase-zero-monorepo
description: PHASE-ZERO v5.0 — Environmental Compensation for SAR-Based Surface Anomaly Detection (100% TypeScript Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
